Add MAD QC flags to a data frame

Source: R/mad-qc-annotate.R
annotate_mad_qc.Rd

Add MAD QC flags to a data frame

Usage

annotate_mad_qc(
  data,
  qc,
  suffix = "_mad_outlier",
  overall = "mad_qc_outlier",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Original data frame used by mad_qc().

qc

A tidy result from mad_qc().

suffix

Suffix for per-metric logical columns.

overall

Name of the overall logical flag.

overwrite

Replace only conflicting veryMAD flag columns?

Value

data with aligned logical QC columns appended.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(1, 1, 1, 10))
q <- mad_qc(d, c(x = "upper"))
annotate_mad_qc(d, q)
#>    x x_mad_outlier mad_qc_outlier
#> 1  1         FALSE          FALSE
#> 2  1         FALSE          FALSE
#> 3  1         FALSE          FALSE
#> 4 10         FALSE          FALSE
